column1: # SKIP CENSUS MANIFEST: the tests that are allowed to skip, and what each one lacked.
# GATE-INTEGRITY-20260819 section 10. `nv27b_twin_parity` skipped when its checkpoint was absent
# and PASSED, and CI ran it on every hosted runner without checkpoints, green in perpetuity. The
# count of such tests is a NUMBER this repo states out loud rather than a property nobody measures.
# Columns: crate <TAB> test path (as libtest prints it) <TAB> the source FILE (no line number)
# <TAB> the skip message exactly as written in the source, format placeholders included.
# THE PROTOCOL (memra #484). A skipping test prints `SKIP[<artifact>]: <reason>`: what was
# missing, then what the test would have proven with it. A per-case test prints one line per
# missing case. Any other skip-shaped print in test code FAILS the census as unstructured.
# Regenerate the rows with `python3 tools/skip-census.py static` and review the diff. Rows carry
# no line anchor: a `file:line` third column is refused, a file that no longer holds the test is
# a failure, and a row is matched by crate + test path + message (memra #484: every line anchor
# had drifted and the drift NOTE fired on every row, so nobody read it).
# tools/skip-census.py verify compares this file with a static scan of EVERY crate under crates/
# (src/ and tests/) in BOTH directions. An undeclared skip FAILS (it would otherwise be born
# invisible); a stale row FAILS (it inflates the budget and silently permits a different skip).
# tools/skip-census.py run counts the protocol lines a run ACTUALLY printed against a named
# budget, default 0, and every line must match a row for its test in full. Where the budgets live:
#   .github/workflows/ci.yml  MEMRA_GGUF_SKIP_BUDGET for the CUDA-free --lib run over memra-gguf,
#                             A hosted runner has no /data and no model checkpoints, so every
#                             artifact-gated row of those crates skips; the budget is the count
#                             of model-backed assertions CI is blind to, stated rather than hidden.
#                             below are integration binaries and the pair-only tests are
#                             #[ignore], so none of them runs there).
#   tools/local-ci.sh         MEMRA_GGUF_SKIP_BUDGET for memra-gguf --lib on the rig, where the
#                             checkpoints under /data are staged and only the rest skip.
#   tools/portable-suites.sh  budget 0 for memra-tier, memra-kv and memra-cli: none of the three
#                             crates has an artifact-gated test, and a new one must be declared
#                             here and budgeted there, out loud.
